title: CPU topology optimization of a small beam (PyTopo3D)

tool_about: PyTopo3D runs up to 60 CPU SIMP iterations on a 12×6×3 cantilever for three material fractions. Exposed voxel faces display its actual density output. Uses the upstream SciPy CPU fallback, with no PyPardiso or CUDA. This is a coarse illustrative problem with a 60-iteration budget, not a converged engineering design. Display threshold is 0.3; the stored density array and mean retain the actual output.
